asr.full_text: What's up everybody? It's Bitcoin Derrick here. I just want to reach out to you guys and let you know this Bitcoin is not a joke. It's a serious business. A lot of people hitting me up but they ain't willing to invest that little hundred dollars into the platform. Y'all saw my messages or my messages I left earlier. I was like, if you ain't go investing yourself, who will? The stuff like that. It's important that you invest in yourself. Don't beg. Don't ask somebody to front you. Because I don't mind doing that. Honestly, I really don't mind doing that for my people. But at the same time, you're not going to take it as serious. If it came out your pocket, you're going to watch it. You know what I'm saying? It's that simple. And it's going to grow. It's going to grow. The key is compounding. This is a compounding Bitcoin opportunity and Bitcoin is destined to rise. Ain't nothing guaranteed. I'm not a financial advisor. I'm letting you guys know that now. But at the same time there's risk in everything. And don't risk anything you're not willing to lose. It's important to know that. A hundred dollars shouldn't be... I spend that at the grocery store, you know. We got to eat. But this can feed your whole family for generations if you do it right. We're talking 15K a day if you do it right. So think about that. Sometimes you got to take that risk. You got to risk something. But always pay yourself first no matter what you're doing in life. Pay yourself first. Stop creating bills. Stop throwing your money away. Let's get it away Let's get it Let's get it, let's eat That's what it's about So you guys enjoy this weekend I'm going to the comedy show to check out some more Here in Grand Rapids, Michigan I'm about to turn up Because every day I know Bitcoin Is making, I'm making more Bitcoin Every day, my team building I'm feeling good I'm motivated That's what it's all about And I want you to feel that way too I want you to get your family involved Get everybody involved Teach your kids about forks Learn how this money flip cause you ain't got to work for nobody if you do this right Trust me Enjoy your weekend
